steps.content: Escorted by Executive Officers and a small number of FAC Elites, you arrive at your target location—the Executive Committee's secret branch.
You feel uneasy even though you don't see any visible signs of contamination. It must be here, but you can't figure out why it chose this place.

steps.speaker: Armed Executive Officer
steps.content: Chief, our messages went unanswered. Something might have happened in there.
The walls have crumbled, the ground has dissolved, and the whole place is blazing with icy flames. There's not a single living soul around. This is undoubtedly the work of that monster.
What shocks you even more is the interior design of the building. Iron bars, shackles, cells, and traces of struggle in the rooms...
This is a large-scale detention center, which immediately answers a question you've had all along:
There's only one reason why the Corpseborne chose this place. Whether it's Rustfire members captured by the Executive Committee, or residents of the Drifter Camp, they were all incarcerated here.
And they all became yummy snacks for the Corpus of BR-002.

steps.speaker: Armed Executive Officer
steps.content: The guards... all dead... The monster...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Get out if you don't want to die!

steps.content: It's time for a sinister game of <color=#fb9259>hide-and-seek</color> again. You summon your shackles, staying vigilant against anything that might come near you. The first thing you encounter is that familiar, nauseating voice.
Distorted Corruptors crawl out of the cells one after another, rushing towards you. You want to find the source, but the stench of contamination surrounds you from all sides.
